response.sql:
WITH track_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / Milliseconds AS bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  WHERE MediaTypeId IS NOT NULL AND Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS num_tracks
  FROM track_rates
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
),
above_avg_types AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.avg_rate,
    mt.num_tracks,
    oa.overall_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats mt
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE mt.avg_rate > oa.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(num_tracks) AS average_num_tracks,
  AVG(avg_rate - overall_avg_rate) AS average_margin
FROM above_avg_types;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL bytes are excluded from rate calculations, since bytes-per-millisecond cannot be computed without a bytes value.
For each media type, its bytes-per-millisecond rate is defined as the average of the per-track rates (not total bytes ÷ total milliseconds aggregated).

alternatives.interpretation: Each media type's rate is computed as the aggregate total bytes divided by aggregate total milliseconds of all its tracks (a single rate per media type), rather than averaging individual track rates.
alternatives.sql:
WITH track_bytes_ms AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    SUM(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS total_bytes,
    SUM(Milliseconds) AS total_ms,
    COUNT(*) AS num_tracks
  FROM Track
  WHERE MediaTypeId IS NOT NULL AND Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    total_bytes / NULLIF(total_ms, 0) AS rate,
    num_tracks
  FROM track_bytes_ms
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
),
above_avg_types AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.rate,
    mt.num_tracks,
    oa.overall_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats mt
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE mt.rate > oa.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(num_tracks) AS average_num_tracks,
  AVG(rate - overall_avg_rate) AS average_margin
FROM above_avg_types;
